subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report access (NDA gating) + timeline alignment
messages:

Subject: SOC 2 Type II report request — NDA gating

Hi Marissa,

Following up from yesterday's security intake, Acme needs access to Redwood's latest SOC 2 Type II report to close our vendor due diligence. A couple of asks from our side:

- We expect the audit period and a confirmation of whether you can provide a bridge letter if the report is older than 12 months.
- Acme requires the report to be exchanged under a mutual NDA (we'll countersign). Please confirm you have a standard NDA and the approximate turnaround for countersignature.
- Any evidence extracts we could surface (control descriptions / evidence index) would be helpful for our InfoSec team — if those are gated, tell us the gating steps.

Can you advise next steps and a rough timeline? We're trying to complete vendor review by Aug 20.

Thanks,
Jordan

Senior Security Analyst, Acme Corp
legal@acme.com

Hi Jordan — thanks for the clear asks. Quick summary of how we typically handle this and proposed next steps so we can align on timeline: 

1) NDA gating: we require a mutual NDA for full-report access. I'm attaching our standard mutual NDA (Redwood_NDA_v1.1.pdf). If Acme prefers to send your legal template we can review but turnaround is normally 2–3 business days for countersign.
2) Report / bridge letter: our latest SOC 2 Type II report covers the period 2025-11-01 to 2026-04-30. If you need an attestation covering a later period we can provide a dated bridge letter summarizing no control changes since the report — please confirm whether Acme accepts bridge letters.
3) Evidence extracts: we can provide a redacted evidence index and control narrative (SOC2_Access_Checklist.xlsx) once NDA is fully executed. Full raw evidence is not provided; we provide indexed artifacts and dated screenshots where appropriate.

Proposed timeline (assuming NDA executed this week):
- 0–2 business days: NDA review and countersign
- Within 1 business day after countersign: share access link to redacted report & evidence index

Cc'ing Ben (sales lead) and Karthik (procurement) to keep them in the loop for any contract/approval items.

Next step: I can send the NDA via DocuSign if that works for you. Alternatively, upload your NDA and we'll route to Legal. Which do you prefer?

Best,
Marissa
